items: Draft replies to common customer and colleague questions with AI, then check facts and tone before sending.
Use AI to fill in and proofread forms, expense reports and records, and compare against the source documents.
Ask AI to summarise long documents or email threads so you can answer requests faster.
roadmap.project: Answer 30 routine emails with AI drafts over two weeks, check each one, and count minutes saved and corrections needed.

roadmap.title: Build templates and simple automations
items: Create reusable AI prompts for your most common letters, reports and replies.
Use built-in automation (Power Automate, Zapier or your email rules) to sort incoming mail and requests.
Keep a checklist for what must be checked by a person: names, amounts, dates, personal data.
roadmap.project: Automate one recurring flow, such as filing incoming invoices or logging requests, and document it in a one-page guide for colleagues.

roadmap.title: Become the office's go-to organiser
items: Be the person who knows which tool fits which task, and help colleagues get started.
Strengthen the work AI cannot do: handling difficult callers, judging priorities, keeping things running.
Look at related roles: administrative assistant, office coordinator, or records specialist.
roadmap.project: Teach two colleagues one AI routine you use, and track for a month how much time they say it saves them.

aiTools: Microsoft 365 Copilot or Google Gemini for Workspace
ChatGPT or Claude for drafting and summarising
Power Automate or Zapier for simple workflows
humanEdge: Knowing who to ask and how the office really works
Spotting when a document or request does not look right

roadmap.title: Use the AI already in your cab
items: Learn your navigation and fleet apps well: traffic, restrictions for heavy vehicles, fuel stops.
Use voice assistants hands-free for messages and calls, never touching the phone while driving.
Understand your truck's driver-assist systems and their limits.
roadmap.project: Learn every feature of your fleet and navigation apps for a month and note one thing that saved you time or a detour.

roadmap.title: Less paperwork between loads
items: Keep electronic logs, inspections and delivery records tidy and up to date.
Use AI on your phone during breaks to understand rules, routes or paperwork you are unsure about.
Photograph and scan delivery documents so nothing gets lost.
roadmap.project: Go paperless for one month with digital logs and scanned delivery papers, and count missing or late documents compared with before.

roadmap.title: Grow skills that keep you valuable
items: Driving safely in difficult conditions, securing loads and dealing with customers stay human work.
Learn about new truck technology: electric trucks, driver-assist, remote monitoring.
Look at related roles: driver trainer, dispatcher, or fleet and transport coordinator.
roadmap.project: Take one course on a new skill (dangerous goods, electric trucks, or driver training) and talk to your employer about where it leads.

aiTools: Truck navigation and fleet management apps
humanEdge: Driving safely in bad weather and heavy traffic
Securing cargo and checking the truck
Handling customers and problems at delivery
